findAccountSlot.description: Which signed-in account slot (authuser index) owns an email address. Navigates /mail/u/<n>/ for n=0..maxSlots-1 and matches document.title against the address.

prepareDraftAs.description: Open a prefilled compose (view=cm) in the given account slot and switch the sender to a send-as alias (e.g. a Google Group address). Never sends. The From selector is hidden on this view: real Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks (not element.click()) on the To row, then the revealed From line, then the alias option are required to change it. Returns a readback of To/Subject/From for the caller to verify before calling sendPreparedDraft.

alias.description: substring identifying the send-as option, e.g. the alias address or "Team Dwarves"

returns.description: {targetId, to, subject, from:[...values]} on success; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

sendPreparedDraft.description: WRITE, irreversible. Click Send on a draft opened by prepareDraftAs. Refuses unless confirm:true: this is the point past which the message is outward and cannot be recalled, so the caller must have already read back prepareDraftAs's {to, subject, from} and gotten the human's explicit go-ahead.

confirm.description: must be true; a human has approved From/To/Subject

returns.description: {sent: true} once the compose view closes after the click; {stop:reason} otherwise

verifySent.description: Confirm a message reached Sent by searching in:sent to:<recipient> newer_than:<days>d and counting result rows.

addForwardingAddress.description: Open #settings/fwdandpop, poll for the form to render (can take 20-40s in a background tab), click the real "Add a forwarding address" button, fill the dialog's email input, click Next. Never touches the inline 'Forward a copy of incoming mail to' textbox (typing into it directly auto-selects that radio and forwards ALL mail). Never answers the follow-on challenge.

returns.description: {status:'challenge', targetId, popupTargetId} when Google opens a Verify-it's-you popup (accounts.google.com); {status:'sent', targetId} when it goes straight to a confirmation email; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

confirmForwarding.description: Open a mail-settings.google.com/mail/vf-... confirmation link from the forwarding-confirmation email and click Confirm.

verifyUrl.description: the vf-... link from the confirmation email

returns.description: {targetId, successText} the page's visible text after clicking Confirm; {stop:reason} otherwise

createForwardFilter.description: Open #search/<query>, Advanced search options -> Create filter, tick "Forward it to" (checkboxes render off-screen, click the label text) and pick forwardTo from the custom listbox, assert exactly that one checkbox is ticked and the listbox shows forwardTo, then click Create filter with real Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks (a DOM .click() has no user gesture and Gmail's verify-it's-you popup is then blocked) and Continue on the verify dialog the same way. dryRun:true stops right before clicking Create filter.

forwardTo.description: an already-verified forwarding address on this account

dryRun.description: default false; when true, stop right before Create filter and return the asserted state

returns.description: {targetId, dryRun:true, checkedOnes, listboxText} on a dry run; {targetId, created:true, checkedOnes, listboxText} on a real create; {stop:reason} at the step that failed
